tools.name: mystreetdata_compare_streets
tools.title: Compare street context
tools.description: Side-by-side contextual measurements for 2–5 distinct IDs. No overall score, ranking or recommendation. Interpret each source period, scale and missing value separately.

tools.name: mystreetdata_get_coverage
tools.title: MyStreetData coverage
tools.description: Dataset version, included states and site-area coverage. This is the site catalogue, not all United States streets. Publication verification means an origin HTML file existed at snapshot time; not a claim of indexing or current freshness.

tools.name: mystreetdata_get_street_context
tools.title: Street context
tools.description: EPA block-group walkability and observed SNAP retailers/EV station counts near the street centroid, with period, scale and missing-data status. Not a home, safety or live availability assessment.

tools.name: mystreetdata_search_areas
tools.title: Find a site area
tools.description: Find a city, county or metro grouping by name; select the state-qualified area_id. Site areas are not guaranteed municipal boundaries. Prefix search.

tools.name: mystreetdata_search_streets
tools.title: Find a street
tools.description: Find streets by name prefix in one state-qualified site area. Distinguishes ZIPs and persistent IDs. Use search_areas first. Never treats a supplied URL as a fetch target.
